funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants

amount.raw: Small, up to £2,000; Large, from £2,001 to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any stage of their career; applicant must be the author or editor of the proposed publication and have a publisher confirmed with publication date within three years.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to disseminate research on British art through publication of monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles, covering practical publishing costs such as image copyright fees.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed; one Research Project Grant per organisation per round.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research in British art, visual culture and architectural history, primarily supporting staff costs towards facilitating a research project with public-facing outcomes and/or legacy.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; the exhibition may be forthcoming or already taken place.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to produce publications related to their exhibitions and displays, covering practical publishing costs such as image and production costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to disseminate research on British art through live, online and hybrid events for a variety of audiences, covering costs such as venue hire, accommodation for speakers and staffing.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking conservation research or technical analysis on items in public or charitable ownership and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Funding to help protect and preserve significant works of British art by supporting organisations to undertake original and needed conservation research, covering staff and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking work to digitise items and material in their own collections.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for organisations to make their collections freely available to audiences online via digitisation, covering personnel and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: ERBA: Research Travel Bursaries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA); membership can be pending at application.
opportunities.summary: Micro-grant for ERBA members to support a specific research trip (e.g. visiting a gallery, museum, collection or site, or meeting a key contact), covering transport, accommodation and reasonable expenses.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals; tiers up to £8,000 open to any career stage, £8,001-£20,000 open to postdoctoral level or equivalent; open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for individuals undertaking research in British art, covering research travel and/or focused research time (including staff backfill, daily rates and supporting costs).

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals enrolled to start (place confirmed) or already undertaking a master's level or doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Fixed grant for students beginning or continuing a master's or doctoral degree in British art who may face barriers in undertaking their course of study.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students at undergraduate level and above, from any country; reference cannot be from current supervisor.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support (from the Andrew Wyld Fund) for students to undertake research trips to examine British works on paper from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries firsthand.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: total of £32,000 for one year or split over two years if part time

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of a master's degree offer at a UK-based institution, due to begin between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master's degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) in British art, part of the New Narratives scheme to increase diversity of perspectives in the field.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: total of £96,000 awarded as £32,000 a year for three years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of a doctorate offer at a UK-based institution, due to begin between April 2027 and April 2028; international applicants may apply but must source extra funding beyond the fixed amount.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a doctorate in British art, covering university fees and living expenses, part of the New Narratives scheme to expand understanding of British art through new perspectives.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: one year at £35,000, or two years at £35,000 per year (total £70,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at postdoctoral level (or with equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to undertake a major in-depth research project in British art that reshapes understanding of the field, part of the New Narratives scheme.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship

amount.raw: Full board and accommodation at the British School at Rome for three months, as well as an honorarium

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre-doctoral PhD candidates to internationally recognised experts.
opportunities.summary: A three-month residency at the British School at Rome for individuals undertaking advanced research on a British-Italian topic (cultural contact, exchange and influence between Britain and Italy).
